definitions.short: the back , i.e. (by extension) the person
definitions.full: H1465. gevah II. גֵּוָה noun feminine back — (so also Di Hoffm SS; ᵐ5 Thes De AV RV body = גְּוִיָּה , compare Ba ZMG 1887, 605 ) Job 20:25 מִגֵּוָה וַיֵּצֵיא it comes out from the back (of arrow which has struck a fugitive, and is then extracted; Hoffm reads מִגֵּוֺה ). — I. גֵּוָה below גאה .
